-- Migration: Add halfvec support for 50% storage savings
-- Requires pgvector extension version 0.7.0+
--
-- Run with: psql $DATABASE_URL -f migrations/003_halfvec_embeddings.sql

-- Ensure pgvector extension is enabled
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;

-- Check pgvector version (requires 0.7.0+ for halfvec)
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_available_extensions
        WHERE name = 'vector' AND installed_version >= '0.7.0'
    ) THEN
        RAISE NOTICE 'pgvector 0.7.0+ required for halfvec. Current version may not support halfvec.';
    END IF;
END $$;

-- Create error_embeddings table with halfvec
-- Using 1024 dimensions (Voyage AI) instead of 1536 (OpenAI)
-- halfvec uses 16-bit floats = 50% storage savings
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS error_embeddings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    error_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    org_id TEXT NOT NULL,

    -- Embedding using halfvec for 50% storage savings
    -- 1024 dimensions for Voyage AI (voyage-3-lite)
    -- Use vector(1024) if halfvec not available
    embedding halfvec(1024),

    -- Metadata for search filtering
    exception_type TEXT,
    exception_message TEXT,
    file_path TEXT,

    -- Timestamps
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),

    -- Indexes
    CONSTRAINT fk_error FOREIGN KEY (error_id)
